title: pcapng Each Section can use independent endianness
summary: The block type 0a0d0d0a of Section Header Block is the same under both endiannesses. Byte-Order Magic should be used to determine the field endianness of this section.
applies: pcapng v1; Section Header, Interface Description and Enhanced Packet Block
detail: The same file can contain consecutive sections in different endianness; the length field is reinterpreted when the next section appears.
boundary: This tag only determines the endianness of the container block fields, and the packet contents continue to follow the endianness of the respective protocol.
relevance: Explains why block lengths can look invalid after a new section even if the earlier part of a capture parsed correctly.
